title: A-Maze-Ox oxygen-transfer operating-point source inventory

source.citation: Schubert F, Heyer J, Lunemann M, Arens J, Steinseifer U, Jansen SV, Schoberer M. A-Maze-Ox: a novel gas-exchange-area-adjustable oxygenator for extremely preterm infants—design and proof of concept. Pediatric Research. 2026. doi:10.1038/s41390-025-04740-4.
source.data_availability: The article says datasets generated or analyzed are available from the corresponding author on request. No request was made and no raw data were retrieved.

experiment_scope.design: Single in-vitro proof-of-concept test; no statistical analysis.
experiment_scope.material: Abattoir porcine blood, ISO 7199 conditioning; no human subjects.
experiment_scope.sampling: At each of five operating points, 2 mL samples were taken before and after the oxygenator; sampling was repeated after 6 min. Measured values from both samples were averaged and gas-transfer efficiency calculated.
experiment_scope.source_locator: Methods > Experimental setup; Experimental setup and data analysis
experiment_scope.unit_limit: One test, five operating points; no independent biological n, per-run identifiers or variance estimates.
